news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 47% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). While dilution might not always result in lower EPS (like if the company is using the capital to fund an EPS accretive acquisition) in a lot cases it does, along with lower dividends per share and less voting power

news.title: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited (BSE:539518) completed the acquisition of Narbada Gems and Jeweler Limited (BSE:519455).
news.body: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited (BSE:539518) agreed to acquire Narbada Gems and Jeweler Limited (BSE:519455) for INR 1.6 billion on August 31, 2024. Uday Jewellery Industries Limited shall issue and allot 4,623 Equity Shares of Face Value of INR 10 each to Equity Shareholders of Narbada Gems and Jewellery Limited for every 10,000 Equity Shares of Face Value of INR 10 each held by them in the Transferor Company. The above-mentioned Scheme shall be subject to the approval of the BSE Limited (“BSE”/ “Stock Exchange”), Securities Exchange Board of India , National Company Law Tribunal, Shareholders and Creditors of both the Companies and other Specific Sectoral Regulator. Fairness Opinion dated September 16, 2024 issued by Corporate Professionals Capital Private Limited, SEBI Registered, Cat

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.81 (vs ₹2.05 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.81 (down from ₹2.05 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.84b (up 87% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹43.1m (down 4.9% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.3% (down from 4.6% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.56 (vs ₹1.21 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.56 (up from ₹1.21 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.36b (up 119% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹58.7m (up 119% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.3% (in line with 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 17% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 6% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
